DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの広告についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about this advertisement?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三種類が並んでいるので、全部まとめて買わないと注文できないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 広告の三品を必須購入セットか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since three kinds are shown together, do I have to buy all of them to place an order?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the three advertised items are a compulsory purchase set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは食卓の組合せ例です。三種類セットの販売条件ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is an example of a meal combination. It is not a condition that the three must be bought as a set.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一品だけでも買えるのですね。家にほかの材料があるので、この野菜だけ欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 組合せ例だと理解し必要な一品だけ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I can buy just one item. I have the other ingredients at home, so I'd like only these vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is a combination example and request only the item you need. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品は一袋単位です。広告の写真と、袋の内容量は見比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-05.translation: This product is sold by the bag. You can compare the advertising photo with the bag's contents quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真の一皿分が一袋の全部だとも思わないようにします。袋の量を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真の一皿と販売袋の量を区別し表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll also avoid assuming that the one plate in the photo uses the whole bag. Please show me the quantity in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the photographed plate from the quantity sold in a bag and ask to see the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示が一袋の量です。必要な分は合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-07.translation: This label shows the amount in one bag. Does it suit your needs?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家にある材料と合わせて二人分を作る予定です。広告にある肉を追加する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅材料と二人分の調理予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I plan to combine it with ingredients at home to cook for two. I don't need to add the meat in the advertisement.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your ingredients at home and plan to cook for two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では野菜一袋だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then just one bag of vegetables?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。組合せ例と購入単位を区別できたので、この一袋だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入単位を確認して野菜一袋を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Now that I understand the combination example and the purchase unit, I'll buy only this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the purchase unit and settle on one bag of vegetables. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。野菜一袋を会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-050-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll ring up one bag of vegetables.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その指示書で作業を始めるところか。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you about to start work with that instruction sheet?

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。紙の準備とありますが、私の持ち場の番号と違います。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指示書と持ち場番号の不一致を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. It says to prepare paper, but the number differs from my workstation's.
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the mismatch between the instruction sheet and your workstation number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの工程の番号が書かれている。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which process number is written there?

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前工程です。回ってきたので自分への指示だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前工程の回覧を自分への指示と考えた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-04.translation: The preceding process. It was passed around to me, so I thought it was an instruction for me.
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how you took a circulated preceding-process sheet as an instruction for yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この持ち場の指示とは分けて確認しよう。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check it separately from this station's instructions.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前工程の作業を代わりに進めず、現在の担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前工程を代行せず現在担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't carry out the preceding process on their behalf; I'll consult the person currently responsible.
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consult the current person in charge without taking over the preceding process. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の指示書は手元にあるか。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have your current instruction sheet?

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。二枚を重ねず、工程番号が見えるよう並べます。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新旧指示の工程番号を見比べられるよう並べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll put the two side by side, rather than stack them, so the process numbers are visible.
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Lay out the old and new instructions so the process numbers can be compared. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態でリーダーに見てもらおう。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's have the leader look at them that way.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業内容が確定するまで新しい指示では動きません。旧指示も勝手に捨てません。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示確定まで着手せず旧書類も保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't act on the new instructions until the work is confirmed. I won't throw away the old instructions on my own either.
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait to start until instructions are confirmed and retain the old paperwork too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新旧の指示を残したまま、工程番号をリーダーへ確認しておく。準備のまま待機を頼む。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-FKI-ECHIZEN-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll keep both old and new instructions and check the process numbers with the leader. Please wait in the preparation stage. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の工程へ回せそうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can these go to the next process?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この一個に傷があります。加工前にあったか、私の工程で付いたかは不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傷と発生工程不明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This one has a scratch. I don't know whether it was there before processing or happened in my process.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the scratch and that the process where it arose is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 加工前の確認記録はあるか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a pre-processing inspection record?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありますが、傷の位置までは書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 加工前記録に傷位置の記載がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, but it doesn't record the scratch's location.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the pre-processing record does not specify a scratch location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 原因を決めつけず、その品を分けて担当に見せよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate that item and show it to the person in charge without assuming the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 傷の場所を示します。磨いて消してから回すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傷を消さず現品の位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll point out the scratch's location. I won't polish it away before passing the item on.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location on the actual item without removing the scratch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの品にも同じ傷がないか確認してくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check whether the other items have the same scratch.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ位置の傷は見つかっていません。確認した範囲を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他品の確認結果と確認範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't found any scratches in the same location. I'll record the scope I checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the results and scope of checking the other items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その結果と加工前の記録を一緒に渡そう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's hand over those results together with the pre-processing record.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 不明な発生時点も明記して渡します。指示なしに修正はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明時点を記録し無断修正しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll also explicitly record that the time it occurred is unknown. I won't make corrections without instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the unknown time of occurrence and decide not to make unauthorized corrections. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発生時点が不明なことも含めて、記録と現物を担当へ渡そう。修正せず残してくれて助かった。では、また後で。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's hand the record and actual item to the person in charge, including that the time of occurrence is unknown. Thanks for leaving it without making corrections. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おそばをお持ちしました。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この小さな器は飲物ですか。先に飲んでよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小器を飲物と思った用途の疑問を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this small bowl a drink? I'm unsure whether I can drink it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the purpose of the small bowl you thought was a drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そば用のつゆです。飲物とは別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's dipping sauce for the soba, separate from a drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。そばを全部この器へ入れるのではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: つゆと理解してそばの入れ方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. So I'm not supposed to put all the soba into this bowl at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is dipping sauce and check how to put the soba in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お召し上がり方を説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like me to explain how to eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。周りの人を真似するだけでは分からなくて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他客の模倣では分からず食べ方の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I can't work it out just by copying the people around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that copying other diners does not clarify it and ask how to eat it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少しずつつけて召し上がれます。薬味も別に添えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can dip a little at a time. The condiments are served separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬味は味を見てから加えたいです。今は混ぜずに食べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬味は味を見てから加えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to taste it before adding the condiments. I'll try it without mixing them in for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to add the condiments only after tasting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、途中でご不明な点があればお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please ask if anything is unclear as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、まず少しずつつけます。この器を飲物の注文に数えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量ずつつけ器を飲物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll start by dipping small amounts. I'll make sure not to count this bowl as a drink order.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Dip a little at a time and distinguish the bowl from a drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご質問ありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for asking. Please enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお弁当のお受取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect your reserved boxed lunches?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、家族も受取りに行くと言っていたことを思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族も同予約の受取りに来る可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I just remembered that a family member also said they would come to collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a family member may also come to collect the same reservation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前とご予約の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I have the reservation name and details?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 佐藤で三つです。別に三つ注文したのではなく、同じ予約のことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名と数量を示し別注文ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sato, three lunches. It's the same reservation, not a separate order for another three.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and quantity and explain it is not another order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受渡しの記録を確認します。ご家族にも連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the handover record. Can you contact your family member too?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いま連絡します。まだ渡されていないなら、確認が済むまで待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族確認が済むまで受渡し保留を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact them now. If the lunches haven't been handed over yet, please wait until we've checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to hold the handover until the family check is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。二重にお渡ししないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We'll check to avoid handing them over twice.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族から、まだ店に着いていないと返事が来ました。私が受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族未到着を確認して自分の受取りを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family member replied that they haven't arrived at the shop yet. I'll collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the family member has not arrived and offer to collect the order yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのことをご家族にもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell your family member that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 伝えました。予約した三つを私が持ち帰り、家族は来ないことになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の来店中止と自分の持ち帰りを確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have. I'll take the three reserved lunches home, and my family member will no longer come.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that your family member will not come and you will take the order home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二重の連絡があったことも添えて、予約内容を確認してお渡しします。ご連絡ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll note the duplicate communication, confirm the reservation details, and hand them over. Thank you for contacting them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided what to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき音がしたので、携帯で選んだ料理が注文されたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別卓の音を携帯注文の成立と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard a sound earlier, so I thought the food I selected on my phone had been ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a sound from another table meant your mobile order had gone through. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面に送信完了の表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the screen say the order was sent successfully?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。料理を選んだだけで、最後の送信をしていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信前で選択だけだったと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I'd only selected the food and hadn't pressed the final send button.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you had only selected items and had not sent the order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その音は別のお席の呼出しですね。まだ注文は受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sound was a call from another table. We haven't received your order yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、いま選んだ内容を見直します。二つに増えている品があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未注文を理解し増えた数量を点検する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll review what I've selected now. One item has increased to two.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you understand the order is not placed and check the increased quantity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数量を確認してから送信してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the quantities before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つへ直しました。注文できたか、画面で確認する箇所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数量訂正後に送信成立の確認箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've corrected it to one. Please also show me where on the screen to check that the order has gone through.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After correcting the quantity, ask where to confirm successful submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送信後の確認画面をご覧ください。分からなければ一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the confirmation screen after sending. If you're unsure, we'll check together.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送信しました。確認画面に一つずつ出ています。もう一度は押しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 成立表示を確認し再送信をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've sent it. The confirmation screen shows one of each. I won't press it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the successful order display and say you will not resend it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでも一つずつの注文を確認できました。追加の操作は不要です。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed an order for one of each on our side too. You don't need to do anything else. Please enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は葉の様子を見てくれるか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you check the leaves today?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口側の一列だけ、葉が下がっています。ほかの列とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一列だけ葉の状態が違うと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only one row near the entrance has drooping leaves. It's different from the other rows.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the leaves differ in just one row. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ見つけた。朝も同じだったか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you notice? Were they the same this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝はその列を見ていません。いつからかは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝の観察がなく発生時点不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't look at that row this morning. I can't say when it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not observe it in the morning and the onset time is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水不足だと決めず、担当へ場所と状態を伝えよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's report the location and condition to the person in charge without deciding it's a lack of water.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追加で水をやる前に相談します。違う列の状態も合わせて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水不足を断定せず追加散水前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll consult them before giving more water. I'll also show how the other rows look.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not conclude it is a water shortage; consult before additional watering. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 葉を取ったり、苗を動かしたりしないでおいてくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't remove leaves or move the seedlings.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのままにします。写真を記録用に撮ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 苗を動かさず記録写真の許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave them as they are. May I take photographs for the record?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave the seedlings in place and ask permission to take record photographs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に確認してから撮ろう。まず場所を案内してくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check with the person in charge before taking photos. First, show me the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から数えた列を案内します。未確認の朝の状態は推測して話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列位置を案内し未観察時点は推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show you which row it is, counted from the entrance. I won't guess about the morning condition I didn't observe.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the row's location without guessing about an unobserved time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 朝の状態は未確認として、入口側の列の違いを担当へ伝えてくる。勝手に水やりをせず待ってくれ。報告ありがとう。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll report the difference in the entrance-side row, with the morning condition marked unchecked. Wait without watering on your own. Thanks for reporting it. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗い場にある道具は、お客様のものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the toiletries at the washing station yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。戻って使うつもりで置いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 浴槽へ行く間の洗い場確保の意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I left them there intending to come back and use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you intended to reserve the washing station while going to the bath. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使っていない間も、ほかの方が利用できるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave it available for others while you're not using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席を取ってよいと思っていました。いま片づけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席確保の思い違いを認め片づける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought reserving a place was allowed. I'll clear it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your misunderstanding about reserving a place and clear it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の道具だけ、お間違いなくお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please be careful to take only your own toiletries.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣のボトルまで私の物かと思いました。私の名前のある物だけ持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣の他人の物を避け自分の名前を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the bottle next to them might be mine too. I'll take only the things with my name on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid someone else's items beside yours and check your own name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前がない物は、無理に判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If something has no name, don't force a judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からないボトルは触りません。私のタオルと道具をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所有不明のボトルに触らず自分の物をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't touch bottles whose ownership is unclear. I'll gather my own towel and toiletries.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not touch a bottle of unknown ownership; gather your own things. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻られたときは、空いている場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you come back, please use an available station.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。同じ洗い場にこだわらず、空いたところを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻った際は同じ席に固執せず空席を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't insist on the same washing station; I'll use one that's free.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use an available place on returning without insisting on the same one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy your bath.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手をお求めでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。手紙に使う分と、図柄を見て保管する分がほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送用と観賞保管用の切手購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like some to use on a letter and some to keep for their designs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request stamps for mailing and for keeping to admire. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず発送する手紙の料金を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's check the postage for your letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。気に入った切手を全部貼ればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手紙を示し気に入った切手を全て貼ろうとした点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I thought I could just stick on all the stamps I liked.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the letter and explain that you had intended to attach all the stamps you liked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な額と、保管用に買う物は分けて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's consider the amount needed separately from the stamps you buy to keep.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使う分の額を先に確認します。保管する方は、貼らないまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送料金を確認し保管分は未使用で持帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the value needed for mailing first. I'll take the ones for keeping home without sticking them on.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the postage and decide to take the collection stamps home unused. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の図柄は、用意できる種類からお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose your preferred design from the types we have available.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この図柄が気になります。飾るためですが、同じ物を発送用にも使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図柄を選び同柄を発送にも使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I like this design. I want it for display, but I'd also like to use the same design for mailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a design and say you also want to use the same design for mailing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用意できる枚数と料金を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain once we've checked the quantity available and the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。封筒へ貼る物だけ取り分けて、残りは袋に入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貼付分と保管分を物理的に分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll set aside only the ones to attach to the envelope and keep the rest in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Physically separate the stamps for attachment from those for keeping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発送用の必要額と図柄の在庫は販売担当へ引き継ぎます。貼る分と保管する分は分けてお持ちください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-ECHIZEN-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the postage amount needed and design availability query to the sales staff. Keep the mailing and collection stamps separate. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その重量を記録してくれ。

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待ってください。かごの縁が隣の台に触れています。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 計量かごと隣台の接触を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wait, please. The basket's rim is touching the workbench next to it.
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report contact between the weighing basket and the adjacent workbench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その状態で測った数値なのか。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was that reading measured in this condition?

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。表示は止まっていますが、正しく測れているか分かりません。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示安定でも測定の正確さが不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The display has stopped changing, but I don't know whether the measurement is accurate.
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a stable display does not confirm measurement accuracy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録を保留して、担当に測定状態を見てもらおう。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's hold off on recording it and have the person in charge inspect the measuring conditions.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はかごを引っ張らず、この状態を担当に説明します。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で引かず担当へ状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't pull the basket myself; I'll explain this condition to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not pull it yourself; report the condition to the person in charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が直した後、もう一度測ってくれ。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please weigh it again after they correct it.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再測定の値だけ記録します。先ほどの値を平均に入れなくてよいですね。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再測定値のみ使い旧値の平均採用を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll record only the new reading. We shouldn't include the earlier reading in an average, right?
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use only the new measurement and avoid including the old one in an average. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不確かな値は使わない。再測定した理由は残そう。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't use an uncertain reading. Let's keep a record of why it was reweighed.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 接触があったことを記録します。次のかごも台の周りを確認します。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 測り直す理由と次の周囲確認を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll record that there was contact. I'll check around the scale for the next basket too.
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the reason for reweighing and the check of the surroundings for the next basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 接触があった記録と再測定の理由を残しておこう。次のかごも周囲の確認を頼む。報告ありがとう。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-FKI-OBAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's retain the record of contact and the reason for reweighing. Please check the surroundings for the next basket too. Thanks for reporting it. See you later.
